Exercise: Dips - Triceps Version

Category:
strength

Exercise Type:
compound

Force Type:
push

Difficulty Level:
beginner

Movement Patterns:

- elbow
- triple_articulation_(shoulder
- wrist)

Primary Muscles:

- triceps

Secondary Muscles:

- chest
- shoulders

Equipment:

- bodyweight

Fatigue Score:
3

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
0.8

Energy Requirement:
moderate

Recovery Time:
24 hours

Goals:

- tricep_hypertrophy
- upper_body_strength

Contraindications:
None

Exercise Variations:

- name: Incline dips, instructions: ['Place your feet on a bench or step and lower yourself to the starting position.']
- name: Decline dips, instructions: ['Place your hands on a higher bar and your feet on a lower surface, lowering yourself downward.']

Substitution Options:

- exercise_name: Push-ups, equipment: body only
- exercise_name: Tricep extensions, equipment: dumbbells

Instructions:

- To get into the starting position, hold your body at arm's length with your arms nearly locked above the bars.
- Now, inhale and slowly lower yourself downward. Your torso should remain upright and your elbows should stay close to your body. This helps to better focus on tricep involvement. Lower yourself until there is a 90 degree angle formed between the upper arm and forearm.
- Then, exhale and push your torso back up using your triceps to bring your body back to the starting position.
- Repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.
